summary:
plan.md is written. Along Pike Place (east, +x) the building climbs from a low green-posted North Arcade shed (y 19) through a 2-storey block to a 3-storey white-brick Main Arcade over a red/white-awninged stall shed, all on a grey stone Down Under that drops west to the bay with window tiers by ground level.
It peaks in a flat-roofed corner block at Pike Street (z 280..311) carrying the red-neon PUBLIC MARKET CENTER sign (red glass over glowstone, east face, y 48..69), a two-faced red-ringed clock, MEET THE PRODUCER and the fish ice beds: the market's postcard view.
Not tested: I didn't run the roof tool's dry-run on any roof, and I placed the sign letters and the clock by hand on paper, so their fit still needs a render. All block ids pass the toolkit's block check and exist in 1.21.1. White quartz-brick Main Arcade over a stone Down Under base, with a green-post stall arcade along the east street face and the open North Arcade shed to the north. The hero is the south-east corner: red neon PUBLIC MARKET CENTER sign, round neon clock, MEET THE PRODUCER board and the fish ice beds. Dusk glow comes from froglight behind the panes, hung lanterns in every bay and glowstone behind the red glass letters.

rooms.name: North Arcade craft market
rooms.purpose: Open covered market on posts. Rows of craft tables at x30..32 with pots, candles and wares, and hung lanterns every 4 z. Warm dusk mood.
rooms.ways_in: Open on the east side at x33 between the posts (z 2+4k). Open at the north end, z0.

rooms.name: North Arcade hall
rooms.purpose: Wider hall with stall tables in rows at x34..38, a flower stall and a baker, and a centre line of hung lanterns.
rooms.ways_in: Open at x40 between the posts, z133..160. Slab ramp from the North Arcade at z132/133.

rooms.name: Street stall arcade north
rooms.purpose: Produce, flower and honey stalls. Counters at x37..39 heaped with colour. Aisle at x34..36. Lamps and hand-painted signs.
rooms.ways_in: Open at x40 between the posts (z 161+4k). Shop doors at x33, y21..22.

rooms.name: Street stall arcade main
rooms.purpose: The heart of the market. Produce, flower and craft stalls stacked with melons, pumpkins, apples, crates and buckets of flowers. A lantern in every bay, canvas awnings and wooden signs.
rooms.ways_in: Open at x40 between the posts (z 161+4k). Slab ramp at z188/189 from the north part. Shop doors at x33, y23..24.

rooms.name: Pike Place Fish corner
rooms.purpose: The corner entrance under the clock and sign. Ice beds of fish at x35..40, z296..309, chalk signs, lanterns and a scale rack.
rooms.ways_in: Open at x41 between the posts (z280..308). Open on the south face at z311, x34..41.

rooms.name: Shopfronts behind the arcade
rooms.purpose: Lit shops seen only through glass: shelves, counters and lamp glow near the x33 glass. Exterior only.
rooms.ways_in: Shop doors at x33, z start+2..start+3, y23..24.

parts.name: South shell: Down Under, main building, corner block
parts.scope: Footings to ground-2 per 7x7 cell. Cobbled deepslate plinth to ground+1. Stone brick Down Under walls with floors at y2, 7, 12, 17. Building C: walls x14/x33, z189..279, floors 22/28/34, walls to y39. Corner block D: x14..41, z280..311, floors 23/29/35, deck y42. West terraces T. Leave every opening as air. Vocab: terrace_edge, du_course, pier_bay.

parts.name: North shell, shed frame, arcade floor
parts.scope: Masses A (x28..34, z0..132), B1, B2 and the S frame. Footings, floors, west walls, green concrete posts, dark oak head beams, polished andesite arcade floor with a smooth stone edge, and slab ramps at z132/133, 188/189 and 279/280. Vocab: post_bay, ramp, pier_bay.

parts.name: Roofs and chimneys
parts.scope: roof.json for R-A, R-B1, R-S, R-B2 and R-C in the dark-slate palette, with the chimney stack cells in keep. By hand: the R-D deck and quartz parapet at y43, the stepped north gable of D up to y45, the slab flashing at x33/34, and three brick stacks. Run roof --dry-run and fix every warning. Vocab: parapet, stack.

parts.name: Facades: windows, doors, trim, awnings, lamps
parts.scope: Window bays on C, B2, D and the North Arcade west wall, each with froglight glow behind. Down Under windows and doors. Shop doors and glazed panes at x33. String courses, cornices, quoins, red and white awnings, a hanging lantern per bay and hanging stall signs. Vocab: window_bay, du_window, shop_door, cornice, string_course, quoins, awning, hang_lamp, stall_sign.

parts.name: Corner landmarks: neon sign, clocks, board, fish market
parts.scope: neon_sign SG at x37..39, y43..70, z279..310. Two market_clock faces (east x41 y35..41 z302..308; south z311 y35..41 x33..39). producer_board at x41, y42..45, z281..299. ice_bed with fish at x35..40, z296..309. Letters go through plaque or bannerWord facing east and are checked in a render. Vocab: neon_sign, market_clock, producer_board, ice_bed.

parts.name: Stalls, craft tables, flower buckets, dusk props
parts.scope: Counters at x37..39 along S heaped with produce. Hall tables in B1. North Arcade craft tables at x30..32, z2..130. Flower buckets, barrel crates and standing lanterns on posts. The aisle and post gaps stay clear. Vocab: stall, produce_row, craft_table, flower_bucket.
